title: Reconnecting Through a Garden
paragraphs: After his father retired, Bilal noticed that he spent most days indoors. The whole family worried because he seemed less energetic than before.
Bilal suggested starting a small vegetable garden in the backyard. His father agreed mainly to make his son happy.
In the following weeks, they cared for the garden together. It gave them a new routine and more to talk about.
By harvest season, Bilal's father seemed brighter. Bilal felt that the garden had grown more than vegetables; it had brought them closer.
